deals.evidence: racheté les 60% du capital détenue par Corinne Limido pour 7 millions d’euros
deals.headline: ORG Packaging completes purchase of 60% of AJ Auxerre for EUR 7m
deals.summary: Listed Chinese food-packaging group ORG Packaging, run by James Zhou, bought the 60% stake held by Corinne Limido (Paris-Luxembourg-Participations) for EUR 7m; the Association AJA kept its 40% minority with blocking rights, expected to fall to 10% after a planned EUR 6m capital increase.

deals.evidence: le propriétaire chinois va injecter 10 millions
deals.headline: Owner James Zhou injects a further EUR 10m into AJ Auxerre
deals.summary: To close a budget of about EUR 20m presented to the DNCG, the owner committed another EUR 10m, taking his investment since the 2016 purchase to about EUR 35m (owner funding, no change of stake reported).

deals.evidence: a cédé les terrains de l'Abbé-Deschamps au propriétaire chinois James Zhou
deals.headline: Association AJA sells the Abbé-Deschamps stadium grounds to owner James Zhou
deals.summary: The members' Association AJA, minority shareholder, voted (seven for, one abstention) to sell the Abbé-Deschamps grounds to the majority owner so the main stand could be renovated; no price was given.

deals.date_text: Decided on the last day of the 2025-26 season; reported 4 September 2026

deals.headline: EUR 10m of owner loans converted into AJ Auxerre shares; ORT Sports Limited passes 97%
deals.investor: ORT Sports Limited (controlled by James Zhou)
deals.summary: A EUR 10m capital increase reserved for ORT Sports Limited, paid by converting part of the owner's EUR 56.8m receivable on the club (no new cash), lifted SAS A.J.A. Football's share capital to EUR 41m and Zhou's holding above 97%; the Association AJA did not subscribe.

name: Association de la Jeunesse Auxerroise
notes: Revenue and the P&L facts are the DNCG's 2024/25 individual club accounts (perimeter: SAS A.J.A. Football + Association), published by the LFP in thousands of euros; 'revenue' is total non-transfer earnings (excludes player trading, which added a EUR 4.2m profit). AJ Auxerre was in Ligue 1 in 2024/25. The DNCG gives financial debts (EUR 1.8m), cash (EUR 14.2m) and shareholder current accounts (EUR 32.3m) but no net-debt figure, so net_debt is left blank. The owner stake is 'more than 97%' as Sportune read it in the company's filings (recorded as 97); the Association's exact remaining stake is not stated (only its statutory minimum of 1%). The board on the company register also lists Matthew Henry Lewis, Richard Michael Robertson Moore, Ranji Kim, Christophe Remy and Thierry Corniot in unspecified roles; no page found explains them, so no other investor is recorded. No valuation published. Attendance (16,555 average, a club record, 94.4% fill) and the 661,000-follower total are the club's reading of the LFP's end-of-April 2025 dashboard for 2024-25; no per-platform counts found.

ownership_summary: AJ Auxerre's professional company, SAS A.J.A. Football, is controlled by Chinese packaging industrialist James Zhou (Zhou Yunjie), owner of ORG Packaging: ORG bought the 60% held by Corinne Limido's Paris-Luxembourg-Participations for EUR 7m in October 2016, and after successive capital increases Zhou's ORT Sports Limited holds more than 97% of the capital and voting rights (Sportune, September 2026). The historic members' Association AJA Football keeps a small statutory minority (guaranteed minimum cut from 2% to 1% in 2026) with blocking rights. No institutional investor is on the register.
